title: Terms of Service
summaryHtml: Navigo is an independent transit information tool. Routes, positions, and arrival estimates can be delayed, incomplete, or wrong. Use the service responsibly and treat get-off alarms as assistance, not a guarantee.
bodyHtml:
1. Who provides Navigo

Navigo is developed and published by Rendra Prasetia, known as lscythe, an individual developer in Indonesia (the Developer). Contact the Developer at contact@navigo.app. By using Navigo, you accept these terms.

2. What Navigo provides

Navigo displays routes, stops, vehicle positions, and arrival estimates from available transit data. Information can be delayed, incomplete, changed, withdrawn, or wrong. Treat every estimate as guidance, not a promise.

A get-off alarm depends on positioning accuracy, network access, device settings, and battery power. It is assistance, not a guarantee.

3. Independence and operator data

Navigo is not operated, endorsed, sponsored by, or affiliated with TransJakarta, another transport operator, or a government body. Service names and route numbers identify public transport services. Information originating from an operator remains theirs and may cease to be available without notice.

4. Access and acceptable use

No Navigo account is required. Do not interfere with the service, bypass security controls, scrape protected feeds, automate abusive requests, misuse transit information to track a person, or use Navigo unlawfully.

5. Maps and offline Jakarta coverage

Online maps are rendered with MapLibre using OpenFreeMap and OpenStreetMap data. Navigo also offers a Jakarta offline map package with limited surrounding coverage. Offline data can become outdated, and areas outside the package may be blank. Attribution shown with the map forms part of these terms.

6. Availability and changes

Navigo is provided free of charge and without an uptime commitment. Features, data sources, and availability may change or end. Material changes to these terms will be announced in the app before they take effect where reasonably possible.

7. Liability

Navigo is provided as is. To the extent permitted by law, the Developer is not liable for a missed vehicle, stop, appointment, fare, or decision based on information or an alarm. This does not remove rights that Indonesian law does not allow to be waived, or liability for intentional misconduct or gross negligence.

8. Governing law and contact

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Contact contact@navigo.app first about a dispute. An unresolved dispute may be brought before a competent Indonesian court.
